chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Ubaydah al-Hadhdha', who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far عليه السلام about capability and the saying of the people, so he said and recited this verse:
“And they will not cease to differ, except those upon whom your Lord has mercy, and for that He created them.”

O Abu Ubaydah, the people differ regarding arriving at the correct word, and all of them are destroyed. He said: I said, “His saying: ‘except those upon whom your Lord has mercy’?” He said: “They are our Shi'ah, and for His mercy He created them, and that is His saying: ‘and for that He created them.’”

He says: obedience to the Imam is the mercy of which He says, ‘And My mercy encompasses all things.’ He says: the knowledge of the Imam, and his knowledge—which is from His knowledge—encompasses everything; they are our Shi'ah.
“So I shall ordain it for those who are Godwary.”
Then he said: “So I shall ordain it for those who are Godwary,” meaning the wilayah of other than the Imam and obedience to him.
“They find him written with them in the Tawrah and the Injil.”

Then he said: “They find him written with them in the Tawrah and the Injil,” meaning the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the Wasi, and al-Qa'im. “He enjoins them to what is right” when he rises, “and forbids them from what is wrong”; and the wrong is whoever denies the merit of the Imam and rejects it. “And he makes lawful for them the good things”: taking knowledge from its أهل. “And he makes unlawful for them the foul things”; and the foul things are the saying of the one who opposes.
“And he removes from them their burden and the shackles that were upon them.”

And these are the sins they were in before recognizing the merit of the Imam, and the shackles that were upon them; and the shackles are what they used to say from that which they had not been commanded to do, in abandoning the merit of the Imam. So when they came to know the merit of the Imam, He removed from them their burden. And al-isr is sin, and it is the burdens.
“So those who believe in him, honor him, support him, and follow the light that was sent down with him — those are the successful ones.”

Then he ascribed them and said: “So those who believe in him,” meaning the Imam, “and honor him and support him, and follow the light that was sent down with him, those are the successful ones,” meaning those who avoid al-jibt and al-taghut lest they worship them. And al-jibt and al-taghut are so-and-so, and so-and-so, and so-and-so; and worship is the obedience of the people to them.
“Turn penitently to your Lord and submit to Him.”
“For them is the glad tidings in the life of this world and in the Hereafter.”

Then he said: “Turn penitently to your Lord and submit to Him.” Then He recompensed them and said: “For them is the glad tidings in the life of this world and in the Hereafter.” And the Imam gives them glad tidings of the rise of al-Qa'im, his appearance, the killing of their enemies, salvation in the Hereafter, and arriving at Muhammad صلى الله على محمد وآله الصادقين at the Pond.

key_terms.الرَّحْمَةُ: divine mercy, interpreted here in connection with obedience to the Imam
key_terms.الطَّاغُوتَ: rebellious false authority opposed to divine guidance
key_terms.الِاسْتِطَاعَةِ: capability or capacity, the issue asked about at the beginning of the hadith
key_terms.الْجِبْتَ: false authority or object of illegitimate obedience to be avoided
key_terms.الْقَائِمَ: al-Qa'im, the one whose rise and appearance are promised as glad tidings
key_terms.شِيعَتُنَا: our Shi'ah, identified here as those encompassed by divine mercy
key_terms.عِلْمُ الْإِمَامِ: the knowledge of the Imam, described as encompassing all things by divine bestowal
key_terms.وِلَايَةَ: wilayah, authority and allegiance connected to rightful obedience

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith interpret Allah’s mercy and the Qur'anic verses about guidance in relation to the Imam and the Shi'ah?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a tafsir of several Qur'anic verses through the doctrine of the Imamate, identifying divine mercy with obedience to the Imam and describing the saved group as the Shi'ah. It also links true guidance, lawful knowledge, deliverance from burden, and final glad tidings to recognition of the Imam, the Qa'im, and dissociation from false authorities.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Abu Ubeyda Al Haza’a who said, 
‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about the capability and the words of the people.
So heasws said and recited this Verse: ‘[11:118] and they will not stop differing [11:119] Except for those on whom your Lord has Mercy; and it is for that did He Create them.

Heasws said: ‘O Abu Ubeyda! The people are differing regarding the correct words, and all of them are destroyed’. I said, ‘(But what about) Hisazwj Words 11:119] Except for those on whom your Lord has Mercy?’ Heasws said: ‘These are ourasws Shias, and it is for Hisazwj Mercy did Heazwj Create them, and it is in Hisazwj Words and it is for that did He Create them.

Heazwj is Saying for the obedience of the Imamasws of the Mercy which Heazwj is Saying [7:156] and My Mercy encompasses all things. Heazwj is Saying that the knowledge of the Imamasws and that which is from hisasws knowledge encompasses everything, they being ourasws Shias’.
Then Heazwj Said so I will Ordain it (specially) for those who are fearing, Meaning the wilayah of another imam (leader) and his obedience.

Then Heazwj Said [7:157] whom they find written down with them in the Torah and the Evangel Meaning the Prophetsaww and the successorasws and Al-Qaimasws (who) enjoins them good when heasws rises and forbids them from the evil, the one who denies the merits of the Imamasws and rejects it. and makes lawful to them the good things, taking of the knowledge from its rightful ones, and makes unlawful to them bad things, and the bad things are the words of the one who opposes.

And removes from them their burden and these are the sins which they used to be in before their recognition of the merits of the Imamasws, and the shackles which were upon and the shackles of what they were saying from what they did not happen to have been ordered with, from neglecting the merits of the Imamsasws. So when they do recognise the merits of the Imamasws, their offences would be removed from them, and the offence is the sin, and it is the offence’.

Then Heazwj Linked them, so Heazwj Said so (as for) those who believe in him Meaning the Imamasws, and honour him and help him, and follow the Light which has been Sent down with him, these it is that are the successful. Meaning those who kept aside from the ‘Jibt’ and ‘Taghoot’. And the ‘Jibt’ and ‘Taghoot’ is so and so, and so and so, and so and so, and the worship is the obedience of the people to them’.
[39:54] And return to your Lord time after time and submit to Him.
Then Heazwj Recompensed them so Heazwj Said [10:64] For them is good news in the life of the world and in the Hereafter.

And the Imamasws gives them the good news of the rising of Al-Qaimasws and of hisasws appearance, and of the killing of their enemies, and of the salvation in the Hereafter, and the return to Muhammadsaww, may Allahazwj Send Salawat upon Muhammadsaww and hissaww Progenyasws, the truthful, at the Fountain’.
en.sarwar: 83. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman from Sama‘a from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious. “. .
God will grant you a double share of mercy, ( al-Hassan and al-Husayn ) a light by which you can walk. .”
[57:28] The Imam (a.s.) said, “Light means the Imam that you would follow.”
